periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented at approximately a 60-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/teardrop shape with the vertical axis longer than the horizontal.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward taper where the patch narrows towards the lower cheek region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Substantial gap between ears, approximately spanning the width of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded convex curvature at the superior margins of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior haunches exhibit a diffuse grey-to-black gradient transition rather than a sharp contrast boundary.
